title: Radial homotopy operator: smoothness, first derivative and derivative bounds
statement: Let P, k, a ∈ ℕ and let ω : ℝ^P → Λ_{k+1} be a C^∞ (k+1)-form on ℝ^P. Then there is a C^∞ k-form ψ : ℝ^P → Λ_k such that (i) ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^a ω(tx)(x, v_1, …, v_k) dt for all x ∈ ℝ^P and v ∈ (ℝ^P)^k; (ii) Dψ(x)[w](v) = ∫_0^1 t^a ( t·(Dω(tx)[w])(x, v) + ω(tx)(w, v) ) dt for all x, w ∈ ℝ^P and v ∈ (ℝ^P)^k; (iii) for all j ∈ ℕ and R, D ∈ ℝ with D ≥ 0: if ‖D^iω(y)‖ ≤ D for every i ≤ j and every y with ‖y‖ ≤ R, then ‖D^jψ(x)‖ ≤ (R + j)·D for every x with ‖x‖ ≤ R. Here (x, v) := Fin.cons x v, D^i is the i-th iterated Fréchet derivative (iteratedFDeriv) and ‖·‖ the operator norms.
